subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Reading an informative essay on Oman Rail; analysing structure; conjunctions
outcomes: Analyse the structure of an informative essay
Find topic sentences and the main benefits
Use and classify conjunctions to link ideas

tf.s: The Oman Rail essay has five paragraphs.
tf.why: Yes: introduction, three body paragraphs and a conclusion.

tf.s: Paragraph 1 of the essay is the conclusion.
Paragraphs 2–4 describe economic, social and environmental benefits.
tf.why: Correct, they form the main body.

tf.s: Cohesion is when different parts are combined smoothly to form a whole.
tf.why: Yes, a cohesive text flows well.

tf.s: An informative essay mainly tells a made-up story.
tf.why: An informative essay gives facts and information.

tf.s: 'Firstly' can begin the first point in a list.
tf.why: Yes, it helps order your ideas.

tf.s: 'As a result' is a conjunction of contrast.
The main idea of a paragraph is often in its topic sentence.
tf.why: Yes, the topic sentence tells you the main idea.

boxes.q: What is paragraph 5 of the essay?
boxes.why: The essay ends with a conclusion.

boxes.q: Which is a topic sentence from the essay?
o: The rail network will also bring many social benefits.
boxes.why: It introduces the main idea of a paragraph.

boxes.q: What does an informative essay do?
Which benefits does the main body describe?
boxes.why: Each body paragraph gives one kind of benefit.

boxes.q: Where is the topic sentence usually found?
o: At the start of a paragraph

boxes.q: What should you notice while reading the essay?
o: The number and job of the paragraphs
boxes.why: Structure is the focus of this lesson.
It brings the essay to a close.

boxes.q: Which sentence uses a result conjunction?
o: The train is fast; therefore, people save time.
The train is fast, but it is expensive.

boxes.q: Which sentence uses a contrast conjunction?
o: Trains are fast, but tickets can be expensive.
Trains are fast. Furthermore, they are safe.
Trains are fast; therefore, people use them.

boxes.q: Which sentence uses an addition conjunction?

hunt.q: Paragraphs in the Oman Rail essay

mcq.q: Which list shows the parts of the essay in order?
mcq.why: Essays start with an introduction and end with a conclusion.

mcq.q: Which two conjunctions both show addition?
Which type of conjunction is 'for example'?
What is the job of paragraph 1?
Choose: Trains are comfortable. ___, they are better for the environment.
mcq.why: We are adding another good point.

mcq.q: Choose: The tickets are cheap, ___ the journey is long.
Choose: Trains carry many passengers. ___, there are fewer cars on the roads.
Why are paragraphs 2–4 called the main body?
o: They contain the main information: the three benefits
mcq.why: The body carries the main content.

o: To link ideas so the text reads smoothly
To make the essay longer only

mcq.q: Why is 'The rail network will also bring many social benefits.' a good topic sentence?
o: It tells the reader the main idea of the paragraph
mcq.why: A topic sentence introduces what follows.
